decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposals would not result in harm to neighbours' living and working conditions and would not harm the appearance of the property or the wider area, in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities, S.2.1 (Non Retail Uses in Minor Neighbourhood Centres and Key Local Parades), S.4.2 (Shop Front Design), S.4.5 (Servicing Arrangements), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments), and T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hard Standings), of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 11am to 11.30pm.
Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.

Condition : 8 - The fume extraction system shall be positioned as shown on drawing No. VFR/360/PP4A and shall comprise a three stage system to include a grease, pre- and carbon filter.  The extract system shall not cause an increase in background noise level in the vicinity.  When the system is operating at maximum, the noise level shall be 10dB(A) lower than the background noise level. To achieve this standard the fan unit and filters shall be located within the building; silencers shall be provided to one or both sides of the fan as necessary; the ducting shall be configured to minimize turbulent air flow and acute bends and duct constrictions should be minimized; the ducting shall be circular; the fan shall be isolated from inlet and outlet ducting using flexible couplings; the fan should be mounted using anti-vibration mountings and a packing material where it passes through any solid structure.  The fume extraction equipment shall be installed and permanently maintained prior to the first occupation of the approved development.

Condition : 9 - Details of a scheme to insulate the first floor residential use from the noise from within the ground floor restaurant shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details shall be implemented before the use hereby approved is first brought into operation.
Condition : 10 - The refuse bins shall be stored only within the open yard area as shown on drawing No. VFR/360/PP/1/A and not within the adjoining access road.

Condition : 11 - The car park shown on drawing No. VFR/360/PP/4A shall be made available for parking purposes for customers and staff before the use hereby approved is first brought into operation.  It shall be constructed with adequate lighting, details of which shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and which shall be installed before the car park is first used and permanently retained.  The car park shall also be maintained and permanently kept in a tidy appearance.  The parking spaces shall not be used for any other purpose.
description: Change of use from (A2) to (A3) restaurant, erection of single storey rear extension, part first floor rear extension incorporating a new internal staircase to the rear, self containment of first floor residential accommodation, installation of new shop front, and installation of fume extraction ducting to the rear of premises
